Looking for a real sandbox MMO again? Welcome home.

We’re hosting a '''video showcase event''' and inviting both veterans ''and new faces'' to show what makes ArcheAge Classic special: freedom, risk, economy, PvP, naval chaos, and player-driven stories.

:video_camera: '''How to Participate'''
Submit '''one video per format''':
* '''Long format''' (YouTube, 2–10+ min)
* '''Short format''' (TikTok / Shorts / Reels, 15–60s)

Showcase gameplay, wars, trading, farming, housing, naval content... anything that captures the world.

:bulb: '''Themes / Ideas'''
Sandbox MMO • Player-driven world • Risk vs reward
From calm farming to chaos • No rails, no safety net
“This is what I was missing” • MMO refugees welcome :camping:

:gift: '''Rewards'''
All participants receive the '''Phoenix Powerstone Pet Skin''' :bird::fire:
Top entries win '''Credit Points''' (up to '''10,000''')

:date: '''Today → February 28th'''

Show the world why sandbox MMOs still matter. :blue_heart:

Submit here :point_right: https://discord.com/channels/1095780016945631325/1470434849927205117
